versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Initial release of the "policy-digest-set" skill.
- Allows creation of one policy digest still per user-named page or step, using only pre-approved public policy points.
- Includes clear instructions for collecting inputs, planning pages, confirming with users, and generating images.
- Ensures no unauthorized or invented policy content is added.
- Strictly uses bundled tools for all operations; does not support direct API or connector use.
- Supports safe, automatic updates and robust task review, retry, and recovery procedures.
